notes: Normalized flat schema: id, name (names.primary), category (basic_category), taxonomy (taxonomy.primary), confidence, address (addresses[1].freeform), locality (addresses[1].locality), operating_status, source_dataset (sources[1].dataset), version, geometry, bbox. Only the first address and the first source record are kept. Dropped: websites, emails, socials, phones, brand, other names, taxonomy hierarchy/alternates and every other raw column.
